Name: Chat Spawns Monsters
Author: Rydrake2
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
Spectrum Stardew Monster Spawner brings Twitch community interaction into Stardew Valley!
The mod connects your Stardew Valley game to the Spectrum Game Mods system, allowing configured Twitch channel point redemptions to spawn monsters directly into your game.
Whether you're farming, exploring the mines, or visiting the Skull Cavern, your viewers can influence your gameplay by triggering monster spawns through Twitch.
The mod is designed to be lightweight, with spawning managed through Spectrum's central Control Center rather than requiring every player to independently monitor Twitch channels.
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]Stardew Valley[/b].[/*]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and make sure it is working correctly.[/*]
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b].[/*]
[*]Download the latest Spectrum Stardew Monster Spawner release.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded ZIP file.[/*]
[*]Place the extracted
[code]SpectrumStardewMod[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Open the Generic Mod Config Menu and locate Spectrum Stardew Monster Spawner.[/*]
[*]Follow the in-game connection instructions to pair your game with Spectrum Control Center.[/*]
[*]Once connected, manage your spawning preferences through the in-game configuration menu or Control Center.[/*]
[/list][b]Important:[/b] Your game must be paired with an authorised Spectrum account before it can receive monster spawn requests. Spawning also needs to be enabled through Control Center.
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Twitch Channel Point Integration[/b] – Allow viewers to trigger monster spawns through configured Twitch rewards.[/*]
[*][b]Progression-Aware Spawning[/b] – Monster availability is determined by your in-game progression and unlocked areas.[/*]
[*][b]Location-Aware Spawning[/b] – Monsters are selected and spawned according to the current game location.[/*]
[*][b]In-Game Configuration[/b] – Manage your spawning preference, difficulty and other available settings through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*][b]Control Center Integration[/b] – Connect your game to Spectrum's central management system.[/*]
[*][b]Streamer Controls[/b] – Start or stop spawning and manage your settings without needing to leave your game.[/*]
[*][b]Safety Controls[/b] – Spawning remains paused when the global safety gate is closed, including after a reconnection.[/*]
[*][b]Lightweight Client[/b] – The mod connects to the central gateway rather than requiring every player to listen to every Twitch channel independently.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer-Oriented Design[/b] – Built with shared gameplay and multiplayer use in mind.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
The following are required:
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.0 or later[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list]You will also need:
[list]
[*]An authorised Spectrum account.[/*]
[*]Access to the Spectrum Stardew integration through Control Center.[/*]
[*]An internet connection for the mod to communicate with Spectrum Game Mods.[/*]
